name: Ultimate Hermes↔Grokbot Bridge
tagline: Runs a Hermes agent alongside your Grok bots, with either side able to take the lead
description: Puts a Hermes agent into the Grok Bot app and lets you choose who runs point: Hermes directing your Grok bots, or a Grok bot directing Hermes. Outbound HTTP and SSH paths plus CLI and webhook returns mean your agents stay reachable and useful from your phone.
author: PixelRainbowNFT
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
